issue: The `records.py` / `records_park.py` split has a fragile circular import. `records.py` re-exports from `records_park` at the bottom of the module (:579). `records_park` does `from . import records` (:27) and expects `records` to be fully initialised. Importing `cli.records_park` first fails: "ImportError: cannot import name '_finish_park' from partially initialized module 'cli.records_park'". Today only `records` imports it, so all callers work.
